Strategy: When feasible residuals are spread wider than the item, take the loosest bin instead of the tightest, preserving tight bins for future items; otherwise use Best Fit. Wide spread signals varied future needs. It may help by saving tight fits, but may fail by wasting loose capacity on items that later prove hard to place.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (1000.0 if r == max(bins) and max(bins) - min(bins) > item else 0) for r in bins]
```
